title: Remove active script locals
summary: Recovered 0x557510 register-call helper as a fastcall Compiler member. Decrements the byte active count and writes current position into each indexed 12-byte local record at offset 8. Caller 0x557904 supplies a zero-extended scope byte. Layout and original source names remain inferred.
test_description: Direct original fastcall comparison across counts 0,1,2,127,128,254,255; targets zero, one, equal, above count,255,256,INT_MAX; ascending, high unsigned 16-bit and duplicate indices; zero/all-ones position. Checks all local records, count, unchanged index entries, padding, context and symbol bytes, and position.
known_limits: Negative signed targets do not terminate with ordinary nonaliasing storage and are not executed in the harness.
Invalid pointers, undersized arrays and pathological overlapping object storage are not tested; original performs no validation.
Original source type and field names are unknown; names describe observed behavior.
